verdict.rationale: Plaid publishes an API reference listing Identity Verification endpoints such as /identity_verification/retry. A Sandbox with fixed test inputs and custom test users lets developers run real calls against the API. Nothing shows the reference itself is interactive or has in-page runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console in the API reference, runnable code samples embedded in the docs, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
